_equiv_note: Concepts booru already has under another name. They are NOT external concepts: the tag path owns them, and its measured co-occurrence gives better dependencies than a reasoned list. Kept as a map so the typed phrase still resolves to the right tag.
_intake_rules: A concept whose referent MOVES WITH THE PRESENT cannot be classified and is discarded. the author's on avant-garde: it "means a fashion/style that is popular right now so avant-garde in 1950s meant entirely different fashion/style than avant-garde in 2000s - it is a changing/fluid concept - not worth/impossible to classify". The test is whether the meaning is anchored: mid-century modern is anchored to the 1940s-60s and stays; vintage fashion is a rolling window and goes.

Before reasoning a concept, look for a BOORU ANCHOR. An equivalent tag under another name means the tag path owns it (biker fashion -> biker clothes). A related tag means its measured co-occurrence fills the dependent fields better than reasoning can (beachwear -> beach gave swim trunks, which the reasoned list missed).

An anchor must be the same concept, not a shared word. Stripping the head noun matched cave painting -> cave and crystal cubism -> crystal; only a descriptive suffix (fashion/style/art/aesthetic/movement) may be dropped.
A pattern is not a garment: tiger print and leopard print apply to almost any clothing, so they belong to the tag path, not a clothes slot.
A fashion is a SET of clothes, not a garment; it expands into its garments, and each is drawn from its variants so colour and cut still apply.
